source: Helix continuous competency — aligned with WorkSafeBC OHSR Part 14/15, BC Crane Safety, Fulford/Cranesafe rigger levels, and SkilledTradesBC Tower/Mobile Crane Operator pathways (Red Seal).
disclaimer: Helix evaluations support employer competency tracking. They do not replace BC Crane Safety registration, Fulford Certificates of Competence, SkilledTradesBC exams, or Red Seal credentials.

tracks.title: Rigger
tracks.authority: WorkSafeBC OHSR 15.2 · Fulford/Cranesafe · BC Crane Safety guidance
tracks.summary: Qualified rigger progression from fundamentals through advanced / load-turning skills, with site lift evaluations signed by supervisors.

stages.title: Rigging Basics (Level 1)
stages.subtitle: Fundamentals
stages.description: Hardware ID, WLL, sling angles, COG, inspection/rejection, hand signals, and supervised lifts. Maps to Fulford Rigging Fundamentals / Level 1 Certificate of Competence (typically 5-year competence card).
stages.credentialHint: Fulford Level 1 Rigger Certificate of Competence

stages.title: Intermediate site lifts
stages.subtitle: Job-ready
stages.description: Repeated competent performance on common Helix picks — concrete day, tables, Doka cart, gang forms — under supervisor evaluation.

stages.title: Advanced (Level 2+)
stages.subtitle: Complex lifts
stages.description: Multi-crane / blind / core / engineered picks. Aligns with Fulford Advanced Rigging (Level 2) and Load Turning & Drifting specialty.
stages.credentialHint: Fulford Level 2 Advanced / Load Turning & Drifting

tracks.title: Tower Crane Operator
tracks.authority: BC Crane Safety registration · SkilledTradesBC Tower Crane Operator · Red Seal
tracks.summary: From BC Crane Safety registration through Level exams, practical assessment, and Interprovincial Red Seal. STC compulsory trade effective July 5, 2027.

stages.title: BC Crane Safety registration
stages.subtitle: Required to operate
stages.description: All crane operators in BC must register with BC Crane Safety before SkilledTradesBC apprenticeship registration (WorkSafeBC OHSR).

stages.title: Level 1
stages.subtitle: Apprentice / SLE
stages.description: Technical training + SkilledTradesBC Level 1 Standardized Written Exam. Accumulate crane-related hours in electronic logbook.

stages.title: Level 2 + practical
stages.subtitle: Toward CofQ
stages.description: Level 2 SLE, ~2,685 hours WBT, BC Crane Safety logbook sign-off, and SkilledTradesBC standardized practical assessment (Fulford).

stages.title: Interprovincial Red Seal
stages.subtitle: Journeyperson
stages.description: Pass Interprovincial Red Seal exam (min. 70%). Earns Certificate of Qualification with Red Seal endorsement. STC: by July 5, 2027 must be apprentice, trade qualifier, or certified JP.
stages.credentialHint: Tower Crane Operator CofQ + Red Seal

tracks.title: Mobile Crane Operator
tracks.authority: BC Crane Safety · SkilledTradesBC Mobile Crane Operator · Red Seal
tracks.summary: Mobile crane pathway — BC Crane Safety registration, multi-level apprenticeship (~4,980 hours), practical assessment, Interprovincial Red Seal. STC compulsory July 5, 2027.

stages.title: BC Crane Safety registration
stages.subtitle: Required to operate
stages.description: Register with BC Crane Safety prior to SkilledTradesBC apprenticeship.

stages.title: Levels 1–3
stages.subtitle: Apprenticeship
stages.description: Technical training (~12 weeks over 3 years), Level SLEs, and logged mobile crane hours.

stages.title: Practical + Red Seal
stages.subtitle: Journeyperson
stages.description: Standardized practical assessment and Interprovincial Red Seal exam for CofQ with Red Seal endorsement.
stages.credentialHint: Mobile Crane Operator CofQ + Red Seal
